summary: Module 05 CONTEXT: stakeholder comms translate tech into business impact; bakery analogy for migration WHAT/WHY; holiday-sale email lesson — answer cost/benefit not CTE jargon.
evidence: Part1: Migration = moving recipes/orders to a better filing cabinet; during move you cannot look things up (maintenance window).
Part2 WHY: Old cabinet slow in Saturday rush → customers leave; new cabinet finds recipes in 3s not 30s before holiday peak.
VP question pattern: what does this mean for the holiday sale / revenue / risk — not how.
